title: ATO Detection & Auto-Containment
description: Production-style account takeover detection and response lab using Datadog detections, Flask webhooks, and Azure Functions for rapid session containment.
highlights: Implements real-time ATO detection and automated session revocation
Uses signed webhook workflows for secure containment actions
Demonstrates cloud-native response patterns for high-risk auth events

title: Azure Event-Driven URL Scanner
description: Secure event-driven URL scanning microservice on Azure Container Apps with Terraform IaC and GitHub Actions OIDC-based CI/CD.
highlights: Eliminates long-lived credentials with OIDC federation
Uses Terraform modules for repeatable infrastructure provisioning
Scales event-driven scanning workloads with queue-triggered autoscaling

title: Splunk Enterprise + Splunk SOAR Homelab
description: 24x7 SIEM/SOAR lab environment ingesting Windows and Linux logs for alert triage and response automation workflows.
highlights: Builds centralized log monitoring across multi-OS telemetry
Implements alert triage playbooks for repeatable incident workflows
Demonstrates end-to-end SIEM to SOAR response automation
